ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 70% low-intensity black pixels and 30% high-intensity white/light-grey pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white patch situated on the distal portion of the right lobe. High-contrast white circular blobs are densely clustered across the mid-to-lower horizontal axis of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels define the leading edges and the proximal region near the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 45-50 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration map. Trailing edge exhibits continuous variations with prominent jagged peaks and valleys, specifically on the distal ends of both lobes, isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward-curving sweep trajectory; leading edges display moderate convexity while the trailing edges follow an irregular concave path due to heavy serration.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High spatial density of roughly circular and annular high-contrast white pixel clusters distributed across the central and lower surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned white linear pixel disruptions; notably diagonal rake marks on the inner right lobe and vertical scratches on the central left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface trauma consisting of dense circular barnacle attachment scars (rosettes) and multiple linear rake marks across both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast 'ring' texture across the lower-central fluke area, resembling a dense field of white zeros or circles against the black background.
